title: Liouville Brownian motion as the walk limit on FK–Ising maps
exact_target: For the critical spherical FK–Ising n-edge map law, assume that a deterministic $a_n\to 0$ gives metric–measure convergence to the unit-area sqrt(3)-Liouville quantum sphere. Do any fixed finite number of conditionally independent simple random walks, each initially distributed according to the degree probability measure and accelerated by n, converge jointly with that space to independent stationary Liouville Brownian motions, in the curve-decorated Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov topology?
